user_request: Integrate expected rewards, agent invasion, safe evacuation and forced abandonment in the lower planning console; reorganize layout and reduce rigidity.
prompt:
Edit the attached selected Chinese dungeon exploration UI into ONE more expressive, fully integrated planning console. Produce a production-quality visual concept, 1672 x 941 landscape, full app content only. No device/browser frame, no collage. The user specifically says the current layout feels rigid and wants expected rewards, agent invasion status, safe evacuation, and forced abandonment all INSIDE the LOWER planning panel, with a redesigned layout.

Keep the gothic moonlit castle/candle/skull/raven scene above. Keep the same visual identity and aspect ratio; modestly increase lower console height to about 65% (top scene about 35%) to accommodate the requested real components without cramped text. The upper picture is atmospheric scenery, free of reward, invasion or evacuation panels and free of route lines. Preserve the chosen left-route/right-node-detail approach but redesign the lower panel as ONE cohesive game instrument with an asymmetric composition and some depth. Not a spreadsheet, not stacked equal cards, not a feature dashboard.

COLD STEEL ARCHIVE STYLE from this project's authoritative palette: charcoal #171d23 / #101419, subtle graphite #232b33 surfaces, control #34414b, white #eef3f5, muted #9ca8b1, silver selection #c4d3da. Restrained machined metal, fine chamfered edges and sparse corner fasteners. Delicate line etching on empty background, subtle diffuse light around the current route, brighter foreground than the last version but no neon or busy texture behind text. Introduce a shallow stepped/chamfered top rail and asymmetric spacing to make the silhouette lively. Keep outer trim moderately thin, with dark-steel tactile craftsmanship, not excessive gothic curls. Readable Chinese sans-serif, intentional 18px body, 24px section title, numeric emphasis. Use four consistent text sizes. Risk/danger values muted rust red; gold only for actual currency icons, no gold trim. Main action silver, never electric blue.

REQUIRED COMPOSITION, all UI below y~325:
1. A cohesive TOP RAIL about 78px tall across the lower panel.
   Left: prominent "探索规划", followed by secondary "恐怖地牢 · D级". Nearby show "探索进度 0 / 45", small unobtrusive progress tick line.
   Right half of the SAME rail: compact agent-threat instrument integrated into the metal rail, NOT a detached floating card. Small agent-silhouette or warning icon, exact label "时空特工入侵", prominent "0%", and readable supporting status "尚未开始判定". A very restrained segmented horizontal indicator beside it, at zero in this initial-state example. No invented time countdown or combat statistic. No duplicated intrusion section anywhere else.

2. The MAIN AREA: route map takes roughly 69% width, right selected-node dossier roughly 29%, separated with a short fine divider and subtle surface shift instead of a full-height heavy wall.
   LEFT MAP is the visual hero, y~420 to~720. Organize 4 branch lanes with orderly spacing, but DO NOT use a perfect 4-by-4 orthogonal grid. Use staggered column positions and gentle individual height offsets, smooth short bends, sparse future nodes and asymmetrical negative space. About 12-15 nodes total. Four routes can fan from the current node without crossing; thereafter lane order stays stable. One or two adjacent branch joins can occur only in open gaps. No X crossings, no spaghetti, no superimposed wire bundle. It must be easy to follow one route with the eye. Current start node at left has a precise double silver ring and label "当前位置". Selected reachable elite node on the immediately adjacent first branch gets a silver ring and label "可前往". Highlight ONLY its direct edge from current, not a chain skipping intermediate nodes. Room glyphs: crossed blades, horned skull, chest, question mark. Future edges subdued dashed gray and nodes visible but dimmer. Ghost-like tiny map drafting marks behind only empty areas, no geographical route drawn on upper scenery. Put compact secondary controls "路线总览" and "当前位置" at top-right of the map area, not in huge framed buttons.
   RIGHT DOSSIER: small heading "节点档案", compact horned-skull emblem alongside larger "精英遭遇", secondary "可前往". Two clean short rows: "风险 较高" (rust-red value), "收益 较高" (white). Helper "准备充分后再前往". At bottom of this dossier around y~775, a silver-gray primary button "进入节点", roughly 400 x 54, largest visual action. Don't fill the whole right column with a giant crest. Keep its primary action clearly away from abandonment.

3. EXPECTED REWARDS: an integrated horizontal REWARD RIBBON below the map only, x~32 to1140, y~730 to840, aligned naturally with dossier primary action region. No separate floating window. Thin top divider, subtle graphite brushed inset. Heading "预期收益" with small clarification "地牢规则预览 · 非已获得". Five compact unequal-width groups, separated only by fine short vertical rules, not five boxed cards. All five real categories must remain visible, don't omit any:
   "首领金币" with value "5,500–6,500";
   "通关金币" with value "5,000 起";
   "竞技场宝箱" with value line "75% · 1,800金" and small second line "强化石1 / 重铸券1必得";
   "精英附加" with value "优质装备 · 50%";
   "祭品范围" with value "普通—传说".
These are illustrative D-grade rule previews, not currently secured loot. Don't sum into a fake guaranteed total. Use tiny metal currency/chest icons if space allows, but text is primary.

4. EVACUATION DOCK: a single clearly integrated low BOTTOM RAIL across the panel, y~855 to930. Separate from route-enter action above using spacing and thin line. NOT buttons over the scenery. All extraction-related items live together here.
   Left zone: small label "撤离管理", neutral steel "安全撤离" button with subtle safe-status accent and supporting text "仅起点可用 · 保留战利品". This frame has the player at the start, so safe evacuation may appear enabled. Elsewhere the UI must not imply safe evacuation is always available.
   Toward the middle/right of the SAME bottom rail: smaller muted danger-outline button exact text "强制放弃" and very clear muted-rust warning "丢失背包全部物品", plus small secondary "需二次确认". The loss warning must be readable, never hidden. Do not label this as safe or imply loot retention. Keep danger visually subordinate to the main "进入节点" button, with comfortable spacing preventing accidental action confusion. No huge red solid button.
Make the whole footer feel physically part of the same control console, no detached cards.

The layout should feel like a deliberate, elegant expedition planning instrument: clear visual focus on next route, useful risk and reward context, expressive asymmetry, four clean distinct lanes instead of a dead rectangular grid. Do not introduce new systems, toolbars, metrics or extra panels beyond the user's requested components and existing node dossier/navigation. No animated/blurred image, no exaggerated ornaments. All named Chinese labels should be correct and comfortably readable.

rules.safe_evacuation: Current implementation shows safe evacuation only at start; preserves backpack.
rules.forced_abandonment: Existing confirmation warns that all backpack items are lost. Keep secondary confirmation and distinguish from safe evacuation.
rules.rewards: Existing five preview categories retained; D-grade numbers used as mock rule previews, not acquired loot.
rules.invasion: Initial illustrative 0%, pending evaluation. Actual UI must consume AgentInvasionSystem state; triggered and defeated states must not be replaced with static probability.
rules.route: Illustrative graph only, not a new fixed generation template. Preserve existing topology, reachability, fog, backtracking and section navigation.
rules.hud: This focused console concept does not authorize relocating/resizing existing HP/MP, party or right-side HUD.
rules.presentation: Generated composition gives the lower panel more height than the requested approximate 65%; precise proportions and readable dynamic copy need implementation after selection.

scope: Only candidate image, provenance and local candidate README added/updated. No gameplay source, config, official assets, tests or runtime verification.
